# Transport metadata parser baseline

`baseline.c.txt` is the unchanged production module captured before the single-pass parser optimization. Its SHA-256 and source commit are recorded in `baseline.json`; the host runner also pins the expected SHA-256. Tests compile it under renamed entry points alongside the current production module, without querying Git history. This source fixture is not firmware input or a recorded scientific frame.

Differential coverage compares the entire payload slot, including untouched payload bytes and fields retained when `hasFrameMeta` is false. It preserves the original first-nonempty duplicate-field rule, optional-invalid-to-zero behavior and `strtoull` syntax. `hasFrameMeta` still does not validate a complete frame or its CRC.

The runner also reads existing real-encoder golden frames in `../config_identity/` and unmodified device captures in `../reference_capture/`, independently checks their ASCII CRC, and compares old/new metadata. No wire bytes or CRCs are regenerated by this test.
